title: Returning Extra Change
english: Wafa buys groceries at a small shop near her office during her lunch break. When she gets home, she checks her receipt and realizes the cashier gave her too much change by mistake, without noticing.
The amount is small, but Wafa decides to walk back to the shop the next day anyway. "I think you gave me extra change yesterday," she tells the cashier, handing back the money honestly.
The cashier double-checks the register and confirms the mistake really happened the previous evening. He mentions that most customers would not have bothered to return such a small amount of money.
Wafa walks back to work feeling lighter, not because of the money, but because she chose honesty over convenience, even when nobody would have known the difference if she had simply kept quiet.
indonesian: Wafa berbelanja bahan makanan di toko kecil dekat kantornya saat jam makan siang. Sesampainya di rumah, ia memeriksa struk belanjanya dan menyadari bahwa kasir memberinya kembalian lebih banyak secara tidak sengaja.

Jumlahnya kecil, tapi Wafa tetap memutuskan untuk kembali ke toko itu keesokan harinya. "Saya rasa kemarin Anda memberi saya kembalian lebih," katanya kepada kasir, sambil mengembalikan uang itu dengan jujur.
Kasir itu memeriksa ulang mesin kasirnya dan memastikan kesalahan itu memang terjadi sore sebelumnya. Ia menyebutkan bahwa kebanyakan pelanggan tidak akan repot-repot mengembalikan uang sekecil itu.

Wafa berjalan kembali ke kantor dengan perasaan lebih ringan, bukan karena uangnya, tapi karena ia memilih kejujuran daripada kenyamanan, meski tidak akan ada yang tahu perbedaannya jika ia hanya diam saja.

title: Staying Patient at Work
english: During a stressful week, Firman's manager criticizes his work in front of the whole team, which feels unfair to him. He feels his anger rising immediately, but he takes a slow breath instead of reacting right away.

After the meeting, he calmly asks his manager for a private conversation to clarify a few points. His manager, seeing his composed tone, admits that some of the criticism was based on a misunderstanding.

Later that day, a colleague who witnessed the original meeting tells Firman she was impressed he did not argue back publicly, since she herself would have found it difficult to stay quiet in that situation.

Firman later tells a friend that staying patient in that moment, instead of arguing publicly, protected both his dignity and his relationship with his manager. Controlling anger, he realizes, often solves more than expressing it does.
indonesian: Selama minggu yang penuh tekanan, manajer Firman mengkritik pekerjaannya di depan seluruh tim, yang terasa tidak adil baginya. Ia merasakan amarahnya langsung memuncak, tapi ia menarik napas perlahan alih-alih langsung bereaksi.

Setelah rapat, ia dengan tenang meminta percakapan pribadi dengan manajernya untuk mengklarifikasi beberapa hal. Manajernya, melihat nada bicaranya yang tenang, mengakui bahwa sebagian kritiknya didasarkan pada kesalahpahaman.

Di hari yang sama, seorang rekan kerja yang menyaksikan rapat itu memberi tahu Firman bahwa ia terkesan Firman tidak membantah di depan umum, karena ia sendiri akan kesulitan untuk tetap diam dalam situasi itu.

Firman kemudian bercerita kepada seorang teman bahwa bersabar pada momen itu, alih-alih berdebat di depan umum, melindungi harga dirinya sekaligus hubungannya dengan manajernya. Mengendalikan amarah, ia sadari, seringkali menyelesaikan lebih banyak daripada mengungkapkannya.

title: Keeping a Promise
english: Iqbal promises a friend that he will help him move furniture on Saturday morning. When Saturday comes, Iqbal feels extremely tired after a poor night's sleep and briefly considers canceling at the last minute.
Instead, he remembers that he gave his word, and a promise should not depend on how he feels that day. He gets up, makes coffee, and drives over to help his friend as planned.
The moving job takes almost four hours, longer than either of them expected, and Iqbal is exhausted by the end of it, yet he stays until every last box is carried inside the new apartment.

His friend later tells him how much the help meant, especially since another person had cancelled without any warning. Iqbal understands that keeping small promises consistently is what actually builds real trust between people.
indonesian: Iqbal berjanji kepada seorang teman bahwa ia akan membantu memindahkan perabotan pada Sabtu pagi. Ketika hari Sabtu tiba, Iqbal merasa sangat lelah setelah tidur yang kurang nyenyak dan sempat berpikir untuk membatalkannya di menit terakhir.

Namun, ia teringat bahwa ia sudah memberi janji, dan sebuah janji seharusnya tidak bergantung pada perasaannya hari itu. Ia bangun, membuat kopi, dan berkendara untuk membantu temannya sesuai rencana.

Pekerjaan memindahkan barang itu memakan waktu hampir empat jam, lebih lama dari perkiraan keduanya, dan Iqbal kelelahan pada akhirnya, namun ia tetap bertahan sampai kotak terakhir dibawa masuk ke apartemen baru itu.

Temannya kemudian menceritakan betapa berartinya bantuan itu, terutama karena satu orang lain membatalkan tanpa pemberitahuan apa pun. Iqbal memahami bahwa menepati janji-janji kecil secara konsisten adalah yang sebenarnya membangun kepercayaan sejati antar sesama.

title: Admitting a Mistake at Work
english: Halfway through a project, Zulfa realizes she made a calculation error two weeks earlier that has already affected three other reports built on top of her original numbers.
She feels a wave of embarrassment and briefly considers quietly fixing it without telling anyone, hoping nobody would ever trace the mistake back to her original spreadsheet.
Instead, she emails her manager immediately, explaining exactly what went wrong and which reports need correcting, even though it means admitting the error in front of the whole team.
Her manager thanks her for catching it early and fixing it properly, mentioning that most mistakes cause far more damage when someone tries to hide them instead of reporting them honestly.
indonesian: Di tengah proyek, Zulfa menyadari ia membuat kesalahan perhitungan dua minggu sebelumnya yang sudah memengaruhi tiga laporan lain yang dibangun berdasarkan angka aslinya.

Ia merasakan gelombang rasa malu dan sempat mempertimbangkan untuk diam-diam memperbaikinya tanpa memberi tahu siapa pun, berharap tidak ada yang akan melacak kesalahan itu kembali ke spreadsheet aslinya.
Sebaliknya, ia langsung mengirim email kepada manajernya, menjelaskan persis apa yang salah dan laporan mana yang perlu dikoreksi, meski itu berarti mengakui kesalahan di depan seluruh tim.

Manajernya berterima kasih karena ia menangkap dan memperbaikinya lebih awal, menyebutkan bahwa kebanyakan kesalahan menyebabkan kerusakan jauh lebih besar ketika seseorang mencoba menyembunyikannya alih-alih melaporkannya dengan jujur.

title: Being Humble About Success
english: After winning an award for her design work, Zahra receives many congratulations from colleagues, some of whom clearly expected her to boast a little given the size of the achievement.
Instead, she credits her whole team in every conversation, mentioning specific people by name and explaining exactly how their contributions shaped the final result that earned the recognition.
A junior colleague later admits she expected Zahra to take most of the credit herself, since that seemed to be the usual pattern among more senior staff at the company.
Zahra explains that staying humble about success does not diminish her own effort; it simply reflects the honest truth that no meaningful achievement happens through just one person's work alone.
indonesian: Setelah memenangkan penghargaan atas karya desainnya, Zahra menerima banyak ucapan selamat dari rekan kerja, beberapa di antaranya jelas mengira ia akan sedikit membanggakan diri mengingat besarnya pencapaian itu.

Sebaliknya, ia memberi penghargaan kepada seluruh timnya dalam setiap percakapan, menyebutkan nama orang-orang tertentu dan menjelaskan persis bagaimana kontribusi mereka membentuk hasil akhir yang mendapatkan pengakuan itu.

Seorang rekan kerja junior kemudian mengaku ia mengira Zahra akan mengambil sebagian besar penghargaan untuk dirinya sendiri, karena itu tampaknya menjadi pola biasa di antara staf senior di perusahaan itu.

Zahra menjelaskan bahwa tetap rendah hati atas kesuksesan tidak mengurangi usahanya sendiri; itu hanya mencerminkan kebenaran jujur bahwa tidak ada pencapaian bermakna yang terjadi hanya melalui kerja satu orang saja.

title: Controlling Envy Toward a Coworker
english: When Rafi's coworker gets promoted to a position he had quietly hoped for himself, he feels a sharp sting of envy that surprises him with how strong it is.
For a day or two, he avoids his coworker slightly, aware that his feelings are unfair but unsure how to shake them off completely on his own.

Reflecting quietly one evening, Rafi reminds himself that his coworker worked hard and deserved the role, and that his own envy says more about his insecurity than about any unfairness that actually occurred.
The following week, Rafi makes an effort to congratulate his coworker properly and offer genuine help during the transition, finding that acting kindly slowly softened the envy he had been carrying.
indonesian: Ketika rekan kerja Rafi dipromosikan ke posisi yang diam-diam ia harapkan untuk dirinya sendiri, ia merasakan sengatan iri hati tajam yang mengejutkannya karena betapa kuatnya perasaan itu.
Selama sehari atau dua hari, ia sedikit menghindari rekan kerjanya, sadar bahwa perasaannya tidak adil tapi tidak yakin bagaimana menghilangkannya sepenuhnya sendirian.

Merenung dengan tenang suatu malam, Rafi mengingatkan dirinya bahwa rekan kerjanya bekerja keras dan pantas mendapatkan peran itu, dan bahwa iri hatinya sendiri lebih mencerminkan rasa tidak amannya daripada ketidakadilan yang sebenarnya terjadi.

Minggu berikutnya, Rafi berusaha mengucapkan selamat dengan sepenuh hati kepada rekan kerjanya dan menawarkan bantuan tulus selama masa transisi, dan mendapati bahwa bersikap baik perlahan melunakkan iri hati yang selama ini ia pendam.

title: Choosing Kind Words During Disagreement
english: During a heated discussion about splitting household chores, Ridwan feels tempted to bring up an old, unrelated complaint just to win the argument against his roommate more decisively.
He catches himself before saying it, recognizing that dragging up the past would only hurt his roommate unnecessarily and turn a simple disagreement into something far more painful for both of them.
Instead, he sticks to the actual topic, calmly explaining his side without insults or exaggeration, even though staying focused feels harder than simply letting his frustration spill out freely.

By the end of the conversation, they reach a fair compromise about the chores, and Ridwan feels relieved that he chose restraint over a cheap victory that would have cost their friendship something real.
indonesian: Selama diskusi yang memanas tentang pembagian pekerjaan rumah, Ridwan tergoda untuk mengungkit keluhan lama yang tidak berhubungan hanya untuk memenangkan perdebatan melawan teman sekamarnya secara lebih meyakinkan.

Ia menahan diri sebelum mengatakannya, menyadari bahwa mengungkit masa lalu hanya akan menyakiti teman sekamarnya secara tidak perlu dan mengubah perselisihan sederhana menjadi sesuatu yang jauh lebih menyakitkan bagi keduanya.

Sebaliknya, ia tetap pada topik sebenarnya, dengan tenang menjelaskan sudut pandangnya tanpa hinaan atau berlebihan, meski tetap fokus terasa lebih sulit daripada sekadar membiarkan frustrasinya meluap bebas.

Menjelang akhir percakapan, mereka mencapai kompromi yang adil tentang pekerjaan rumah, dan Ridwan merasa lega karena ia memilih menahan diri daripada kemenangan murahan yang akan merugikan persahabatan mereka secara nyata.
